_readme: Mediavine (Journey) ads on milecheckapp.com. Read by scripts/add-mediavine.mjs (writes the tags) and scripts/check-mediavine.mjs (fails the build if a page is wrong).
Plan and reasons: docs/mediavine-plan-2026-10-30.md in the app repo.

enabled:false = every ad tag and blocklist is stripped on the next finish-pages run (the rollback, and the state until onboarding gives the site ID). enabled:true requires siteId from the Journey dashboard, Settings > Ad Setup, or the scripts refuse to run. Footer privacy links stay either way.

noScript: path prefixes that get no ad script at all: store TV boards, drafts, redirects, thin stubs, sales pages, app download pages, and the full-screen mile-marker map until it is tested (ChatGPT review round 2: no third-party script where no ads are intended).
Any page with a robots noindex meta also gets no script (drafts, previews, admin pages).
Other apps' privacy and terms pages hosted here get no script: they promise no ad sharing for those apps.
blockAll: path prefixes that carry the script but block every ad. Empty at launch; use it for a page that must stay verifiable but ad-free, e.g. a sponsored page.

Pages with an interactive map (they load map-kit.js) get mapBlock: floating units off so nothing covers map controls. Journey says blocklists are not for most high-traffic pages, so review this after the placeholder test.

contentExpect: representative pages and the class journey-content must land on (null = none). The check fails if the scanner picks something else. liveSamples: pages always included in the --live check.

privacyExempt: pages that need no privacy link (store displays, redirects, admin, fragments, drafts, verification files). Every other page with a <head> and <body> must link the privacy policy, ads or not.

adsTxtRequired: the seller lines Journey requires, copied from the dashboard at onboarding (e.g. its mediavine.com DIRECT line). The check fails while ads are on and this is empty or a line is missing from /ads.txt.
fullScreenTools: path regexes for full-screen map tools. No ad script and no inserted privacy link (it would sit under the map); they open from pages that carry both.

adsTxtSource: Mediavine's hosted ads.txt for this site. /ads.txt is a verbatim copy; refresh it when the dashboard's ads.txt health check turns yellow or red. Program is Mediavine Official (not Journey), script host scripts.mediavine.com.
